alt.en: A large indigo book with a ring emblem lies at the center of a gray floor. On the right, a dashed orange line carrying one packet runs to it from a stack of teal-edged papers. On the left, a dotted indigo arc rises from a red rubber stamp and comes down onto the book.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央平放着一本带圆环标志的大号靛蓝色书。右侧一叠青绿色纸张通过一条带数据包的橙色虚线连向它；左侧一枚红色印章上方升起一条靛蓝色点线弧，落在书上。

caption.en: Illustration: decision records, shown as papers, are added to an anchored log, shown as a book, and a stamp stands for the signing key that attributes each record, as the VAP draft describes. It does not depict a tested VAP deployment, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：按照 VAP 草案的描述，以纸张表示的决策记录被写入以书表示的锚定日志，印章代表为每条记录确定归属的签名密钥。图中并非经过测试的 VAP 部署，也不表明这些检查能按描述发挥作用。

items.note: focal: the anchored log of auditable decision records
the signing key that attributes a record
